title: Relative-Entropy Variational Principle for Semiclassical Gravity with Finite-Resolution Boundaries
content: We propose a causal-diamond formulation of semiclassical gravity where a finite-resolution boundary regulator supplies the edge structure for a local Wheeler–DeWitt description.
